children: SAYS CONTINUED EQUITY MARKET WEAKNESS PUTS GOLD AT RISK OF BREAKING THE NEXT MAJOR SUPPORT LEVEL AT USD3,400/OZ
SAYS IT IS TOO EARLY TO CALL A HALT TO THE GOLD SLIDE, BUT THE SELLOFF MAY HAVE LIMITS
SAYS TRADE DISTORTIONS ARE TRADITIONALLY GOLD POSITIVE, BUT POSSIBLE THAT PROPOSED TARIFFS IMPACT SILVER AND PGM INTENSIVE INDUSTRIES
SAYS IT PROJECTS SILVER DEFICIT THIS YEAR, EVEN IN THE FACE OF HIGH TECH AND INDUSTRIAL DEMAND DECLINES
SAYS IT DOES NOT ENVISAGE THAT ANY FRESH TARIFFS WILL PROPEL SILVER HIGHER BY THEMSELVES UNLESS AIMED AT MEXICO AND CANADA
